question: Should OpenClaw accept `gateway.reload.autoRestartOnRequired` plus always-on hot-mode restarts for gateway auth, auth profile/order, and provider SecretRef rotations as the public reload contract?
rationale: This PR adds a public config key, changes existing hot-mode RPC restart behavior, and introduces unattended restarts for auth/provider config changes, so automation cannot choose the operator-facing contract.

options.title: Approve Split Contract After Fixes
options.body: Keep routine hot-mode file edits warn-and-keep by default, allow opt-in automatic restart, and always restart security-critical auth/provider changes after the RPC consistency bug, docs, and proof gaps are fixed.

options.title: Narrow To Current RPC Semantics
options.body: Preserve direct restarts for restart-required RPC writes and limit this PR to watcher policy, diagnostics, or explicit writer intent until a broader contract is designed.

options.title: Pause The Config Surface
options.body: Hold or close this branch if the new reload option and unattended restart split are not ready to become a supported public contract.

recommendation.title: Approve Split Contract After Fixes
recommendation.body: Keep routine hot-mode file edits warn-and-keep by default, allow opt-in automatic restart, and always restart security-critical auth/provider changes after the RPC consistency bug, docs, and proof gaps are fixed.

likelyOwner.reason: The local history points to Vincent Koc as the most recent owner of the relevant gateway reload and config write paths in current main.
